risk: Plan freshness and active-plan selection derived recency from filesystem mtime, which a git clone rewrites to the checkout time, so a months-old route plan reported an age of 0h and passed the 48h freshness gate while ls -t picked an arbitrary plan on the resulting mtime tie.
mitigation: Resolve plan recency from committed git history for tracked, clean plans and from a declared ISO-8601 UTC Plan Timestamp otherwise; fail closed on a missing, unparseable, or future timestamp; route every plan reader through one shared resolver so no call site can reintroduce mtime.
closure: Closed by PR #278, reviewed head c6ace6f4e2d8d270cc9c14cb47c839a059990b27, owner-approved squash merge aaa2fba184e4847718a94b14e0b605de0739b4e8. scripts/enforcement/lib/plan-time.sh is the single owner of plan recency: committed history for tracked clean plans, the declared ISO-8601 UTC Plan Timestamp otherwise, and a named fail-closed refusal for a missing, unparseable or future timestamp. A post-merge audit found one residual presentation-only bypass in scripts/session-setup.sh: the Existing plans list still used ls -lt and displayed checkout mtime even though the blocking freshness path already used the resolver. PR #282 routes that display through eos_plans_by_recency and adds a production-wide regression scan, preventing any executable plan reader from bypassing the resolver. The original 11 clone-safety checks were demonstrated to fail against the pre-fix implementation; post-merge validation for PR #278 remained green on main aaa2fba.
notes: Reproduced on a fresh clone: all 118 tracked plans shared one mtime, ls -t selected a plan last changed 58 days earlier, and the gate computed 0h. The post-closure audit caught the remaining session display before final stage acceptance; KG7 in core/hooks-policy.md remains the separate semantic-relevance limit.

risk: Operational evidence keys on an incidental mechanism rather than on the work itself, so work that genuinely happened is recorded as not having happened. Instance 1: tests_run matched the ENTIRE Bash command with re.fullmatch, so a cd prefix, an && chain, a pipe or a redirect made a real enforcement suite run invisible while the suite executed and passed. Instance 2: superpowers_verify_run keyed on a Read of .claude/commands/superpowers-verify.md, so running the identical verification as a skill recorded nothing, and no producer for skill_used existed at all outside that one path.
mitigation: Move each evidence key onto the work: let the component that actually executes the suites record them from inside the execution, classify a Bash command by control-operator segment instead of matching the whole string, record verification from the skill invocation as well as any canonical verification asset, reconcile the runtime evidence view against the canonical discovered corpus in CI on the exact head, and add a negative fixture that fails when an executed suite leaves no runtime record.
closure: Closed by PR #279, reviewed head 21667557435e7677d09f1c817e6532021933ea2d, owner-approved squash merge b64050e99ca194a6aaa6f72ceb671bf30f085b27. Evidence now keys on the work: run-enforcement-tests.sh records bash_suite_run <path>:<result> and tests_run <path> from inside the execution via lib/test-run-evidence.sh, so no command wrapper can suppress it; direct invocations are classified per control-operator segment by lib/bash_test_invocation.py with masked and backgrounded forms never recorded; and post-tool-use-skill-evidence.sh records verification from the skill invocation as well as from any canonical superpowers-verify asset. A full corpus run from an emptied ledger reports 118/118 Bash suites represented, and the negative fixture proves detection by executing suites with recording suppressed and requiring reconciliation to fail. 30 checks green on the exact reviewed head with 0 unresolved review threads, including the reconciliation step. Post-merge on main b64050e all green: post-merge-validation run 107, enforcement-tests run 1663 (reconciliation as step 22), known-gaps-live-state run 80, telemetry-handoff-tests run 565.
notes: One defect class, two registered instances, per owner decision phase3-gap-class-scope. The evidence ledger records bash_suite_run <path>:<result>; reconciliation reads the latest record per suite.
